items.action: None, unless the app sets data-theme on <html> before startup and still wants the OS to drive the theme: set that attribute before startup only when the user has saved a choice.
items.appliesWhen: Apps calling provideDsTheme({ followSystem: true }) whose <html> already carries data-theme when the app starts, from index.html or a pre-bootstrap script. Apps without followSystem, or with no data-theme at startup, are unchanged.
items.pitfall: A data-theme hard-coded in index.html now pins the theme for every user, so the OS switch silently stops working.
items.verify: with followSystem on, an <html> that starts with data-theme keeps that value across an OS colour-scheme change, and one that starts without it follows the OS.

items.action: None, unless a group projects more avatars than max and all of them should stay visible: raise max to that count.
items.appliesWhen: ds-avatar-group elements projecting more ds-avatar children than max (default 4), or projecting more than max with no total. Groups projecting max or fewer avatars render as before.
items.verify: a group projecting more avatars than max shows max avatars followed by a +N chip whose N is the hidden count, or total - max when total is set.

items.action: Build after upgrading, and rename a member of yours the compiler reports as colliding.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends AvatarGroupComponent, ChartComponent or ColumnSeriesComponent. Template users of ds-avatar-group, ds-chart and dsColumnSeries need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.pitfall: A redeclared private member collides as a public one does, and override cannot resolve it (TS2415); only a rename does.
items.verify: The app builds with no TS2415 or TS4114 against AvatarGroupComponent, ChartComponent or ColumnSeriesComponent.
items.note: AvatarGroupComponent gained the private avatars; ChartComponent the protected highlightBand and tooltipGap and the private bandAt, hoveredCategory and pinRise; ColumnSeriesComponent the private pinYOf.

items.action: Where your stylesheet reads one of these names, set it yourself on :root with the value from restore, or write the value in place.
items.appliesWhen: Only stylesheets of yours that read one of the listed names in var(). No DS component read any of them, so nothing in the library changes how it renders.
items.pitfall: A var() with no fallback on a missing name is invalid at computed-value time and silently drops the whole declaration, so a width or padding falls back to its initial value without a build error.
items.restore: :root { --switch-thumb-travel: 16px; --tag-close-size: 14px; --field-textarea-min: 96px; --field-num-stepper-w: var(--space-8); --form-section-label-w: 280px; --page-header-sub-mt: var(--space-1); --field-select-pad-r: var(--space-6); --tag-close-glyph: var(--icon-xs); --menu-minw: 200px; --menu-sep-h: var(--border-width-default); --toast-enter-y: var(--space-1); --picker-offset: var(--space-1); --cmdk-w: 560px; --cmdk-list-maxh: var(--popover-maxh); --modal-enter-y: var(--space-2); --errorpage-body-maxw: 520px; --wizard-body-minh: 200px; --wizard-step-bar-w: var(--space-8); --inline-edit-input-minw: var(--space-20); --inline-edit-btn-size: var(--hit-xs); --settings-nav-w: 220px; --settings-row-label-w: 240px; --settings-row-label-gap: var(--space-0-5); --matrix-maxh: 360px; --matrix-cell-pad-y: var(--space-2); --matrix-cell-pad-x: var(--space-2-5); --matrix-cell-minw: var(--space-16); --matrix-rowhdr-minw: 160px; --calendar-rowlabel-w: 160px; --calendar-row-h: var(--hit-touch); --calendar-cell-min: var(--hit-cozy); --calendar-cell-pad: var(--space-1); --calendar-bar-h: var(--space-8); --calendar-bar-inset-y: var(--space-2); --binpack-bay-h: var(--hit-touch); --map-chip-pad-y: var(--space-1-5); --map-chip-pad-x: var(--space-2-5); --map-chip-inset: var(--space-3); --chart-empty-h: 160px; --chart-skeleton-h: 160px; --chart-legend-dot: var(--icon-2xs); --compare-dt-w: 90px; --dodont-stage-minh: 100px; --statemap-arrow-w: var(--space-8); --statemap-arrow-cap: var(--space-1); --grid-table-min: 220px; --grid-cols-card-minh: 120px; --grid-cols-card-thumb: 80px; --scroll-spec-h: 220px; --tab-spec-maxw: 220px; --tab-spec-dot-offset: var(--border-width-strong); }
items.note: --switch-thumb-travel also had per-density values (10px compact, 14px, 20px), none of them read.
items.verify: No stylesheet of yours reads one of the listed names without declaring it.

informational: --ds-topbar-crumb-text-color, --ds-topbar-crumb-hover-text-color, --ds-topbar-crumb-separator-icon-color, --ds-topbar-crumb-current-text-color, --ds-page-header-crumb-text-color and --ds-page-header-crumb-text-color-hover now recolour the projected ds-breadcrumbs, where they changed nothing; an app that set them sees those colours take effect.
ds-bar-chart draws a row with a negative value as an empty track labelled with that value, where it drew a bar of the absolute value labelled 0.

ds-button with routerLink or href, disabled and a disabledReason keeps a Tab stop (tabindex 0, role link) so the reason is announced; without disabledReason a disabled link-button still takes tabindex -1.

provideDsIcons calls merge: sibling calls and a lazy route's call add to the icons registered above them, a later call winning a shared name, where each call replaced the previous registry. DS_ICON_REGISTRY now reads the merged registry.

ds-modal confirmed fires when a projected element carrying the new dsModalConfirm directive (ModalConfirmActionDirective) is pressed; before, nothing emitted it. A handler that emitted confirmed by hand keeps working.

informational.text: ds-chart draws a held category's pin at the head of the reading its panel opens over instead of at the plot's foot (over a column too short to hold it, with the panel lifted over the disc), and paints its hover band (--ds-chart-hover-bg-color) under a pin only where the pointer is; ds-bar-chart draws a held bar's pin at the middle of the bar instead of its start.
informational.verify: pin a category in a composed ds-chart and a row in a ds-bar-chart, move the pointer off the plot, and confirm the pin sits right under the panel and no band stays tinted.
